text:
Served items: a latte in a tall mug (~12 oz, mostly milk), sautéed mushrooms (~80 g), a slice of baguette (~40 g), and a chocolate chip muffin (~80 g).

Estimated served energy:
- Latte: ~150 kcal
- Mushrooms with oil: ~70 kcal
- Baguette slice: ~110 kcal
- Muffin: ~300 kcal
- Total: ~630 kcal

Leftovers: the mushrooms and bread are gone. The latte has a little residue (~10 kcal). The muffin looks mostly eaten from the top, but the base and paper liner remain. The muffin top is still visible and looks partly intact, so I estimate about 40% of it is left (~120 kcal). Total leftover is ~130 kcal.

Eaten: 630 − 130 = 500 kcal.

Macronutrients eaten:
- Latte (~140 kcal): 9 g protein, 12 g carbs, 7 g fat
- Mushrooms: 3 g protein, 4 g carbs, 5 g fat
- Bread: 4 g protein, 22 g carbs, 0.5 g fat
- Muffin, about 60% eaten (~180 kcal): 3 g protein, 25 g carbs, 8 g fat
- Total: ~19 g protein, ~63 g carbs, ~20 g fat
